name: fleet
description: Observe-only fleet band and /fleet pane: shepherd tracks blocked, in review or stale, sessions waiting on you, and whether headless claude -p runs really finished.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Draw the one-line fleet band above the prompt. Off leaves the band to other mods; /fleet still opens the pane.

tracks.title: Shepherd tracks
tracks.description: Read `shepherd status --all --json` on each refresh. Off when shepherd is not installed or not wanted here.

sessions.title: Claude Code sessions
sessions.description: Read `claude agents --json --all` on each refresh: who waits on you, which background sessions work.

shepherd_bin.title: shepherd executable
shepherd_bin.description: The shepherd command: a name looked up on PATH, or a path (~/ is your home).

claude_bin.title: claude executable
claude_bin.description: The claude command used for `claude agents --json --all`: a name on PATH, or a path.

runs.title: Headless run logs
runs.description: Globs of `claude -p --output-format stream-json` logs, each `Label=glob` or a bare glob, such as `Nightly=~/logs/nightly-*.jsonl`. Wildcards in the file name only.

sources_file.title: Sources file
sources_file.description: Optional JSON file of more run sources: stream-json globs with schedules, and text logs judged by their last matching line (see the README).

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often a live session reads again; sessions share what one read a moment ago.

stale_hours.title: Stale after (hours)
stale_hours.description: An active track with no activity for this long, or whose owner session ended, counts as stale.
